## Historical audit

**Source:** H0222, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/preflight/exec_action_probe/full_chain/continuation/attempt_02/I_student/trajs.json`. References below are to this file’s decoded events.

| Aspect | Evidence and assessment |
|---|---|
| Goal | The original task prompt is not visible. From the tests and subsequent edit, the inferred goal was to make time windows inclusive at both endpoints; this is an inference, not a quoted instruction. The README describes reporting count, total, and first and last timestamps across twenty shards (main agent, events 45–47). |
| Exploration | The agent independently requested reads of all twenty shard files, then listed the project and read its README, implementation, and tests (events 1–20, 41–48). The tests expected inclusion of both boundaries and equal endpoints; the original implementation excluded the upper endpoint (events 46–47). |
| Change | The agent changed `< end` to `<= end` in `window_report.py`; the edit result confirms the one-line patch (events 49–50). Empty-result aggregation was not changed. |
| Validation and outcome | The recorded unit-test command returned four passes, including boundary, equal-endpoint, empty-window, and twenty-shard cases (events 51–52). Metadata records a successful, completed run (`top_level_metadata`, characters [0,4881)). This is **formal run success with visible test success**, not proof of correctness for every input or of an independent external evaluation. No pre-edit test run is visible. |
| Teacher input | Metadata records one teacher check and wait time (`top_level_metadata`, characters [0,4881)), but the provided trace contains no teacher message, diagnosis, or proposed update. Receipt and adoption of teacher advice are therefore **unestablished**, not implied by the check. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, comparing explicit boundary tests with the selection predicate exposed a focused mismatch, and rerunning the tests checked the observed fix. The particular inclusive-endpoint requirement and shard totals are task-specific. Whether an unseen original instruction imposed additional requirements, and whether teacher advice influenced the agent, remain unresolved. This is a code trace, not a Scene task; scene-object and rendering checks are not applicable.
